capabilities: Shows a daily dashboard with live clock, weather chip and video hero
Captures thoughts, articles and books into structured inbox notes
Lists today's and overdue tasks, meetings, recent notes and vault stats
Opens or creates daily notes from a month calendar
Exposes CLI commands and obsidian:// URI actions for agents and shortcuts
disambiguation: Not an AI agent or chat tool; it is a dashboard view that agents and scripts can drive through CLI commands and obsidian:// links.
extras: Weather is off by default and needs no API key; the animated hero video must be downloaded separately from the repository; CLI commands need Obsidian 1.12.7+ with the command line interface enabled, while URI actions work on desktop and mobile.
intentEvidence: No Dataview, no Templater, no other plugins required.
problem: Obsidian has no single at-a-glance daily view that gathers tasks, calendar, captures and meetings without Dataview or Templater.
